parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating sash of the window made of wood, which holds the glass panel and allows it to open or close.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the movable part of the window that can rotate around a hinge to allow ventilation or access.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a horizontal or vertical axis depending on hinge placement, enabling the window to open or close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame or base body of the window, made of wood, providing structural support for the rotating sash.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the rotating sash and holds the window assembly in place within a wall or structure.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it serves as the fixed support for the rotating part.
